target_paper: Daan van Berkel and Wieb Bosma, On t-sumfree sequences, arXiv:2609.16843v2
conjecture_statement: For every d >= 3 the 3-sumfree sequence S_{1, d-1, 2d-1} is ultimately periodic, and, with the exception of d=3 or d=5, the preperiod length is d+3 and the period length is d modulo 8d-1.

d4_counterexample.reason: d=4 is not exempted in Conjecture 4, yet has minimal period p=3 != 4 and modulus m=27 != 31.

d6_counterexample.reason: For every d >= 6, the true modulus is 8d-3 (45 at d=6), not 8d-1 (47 at d=6).

negative_controls.description: Conjecture 4 at d=4: k=7, p=4, modulus m=31 using actual first 11 greedy terms
Conjecture 4 at d=6: k=9, p=6, modulus m=47 instead of 45
Corrupted preperiod at d=6: last preperiod entry mutated 23 -> 24
Non-minimal period multiple 2p=12, 2m=90 at d=6 (set-equivalent to S_{1,5,11})
Non-minimal preperiod k+p=15 at d=6 (set-equivalent to S_{1,5,11} with T_0 absorbed into preperiod)
